title: Summer's End
start: Talk to Summer near the Wilderness wall northeast of Varrock, north of the Varrock Saradominist church.

items.t: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (unless the player has claimed the reward for completing the hard Morytania achievements)
At least 1 Summoning pouch made with a blue charm. (Bring more in case you make a mistake)
The lowest level pouches are: Albino rat pouch (sc | Summoning | 23 ), Spirit kalphite pouch (sc | Summoning | 25 ) and Giant chinchompa pouch (sc | Summoning | 29 )
For Ironman, Albino rat pouches are easily obtainable, as their tertiary ingredient, raw rat meat, can be bought in bulk from the Rufus's Meat Emporium in Canifis or obtained by killing giant rats.

recommended.t: Super energy potions or a fair number of Mint cakes, or 2 doses of Stamina potion for the fights.
Alternately, use the salt-water spring at Oo'glog (requires completion of As a First Resort)
5-15 empty spaces for logs during the first fight
To get to the quest start quickly, players can use:
20 Archaeology to quickly reach the Infernal Source Dig Site through the dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild
Fort Forinthry lodestone, built after completing New Foundations quest
A Fort Forinthry Teleport, buyable on the Grand Exchange

Do not bring armour as it will not protect you from the attacks. However, either Warpriest of Saradomin armour or Warpriest of Zamorak armour has a chance to reduce damage taken from the Beast's attacks.
Full prayer points or prayer potions, needed to bless the graves

rewards.t: A spirit shield and the ability to wield all Spirit shields
An upgraded version of Jennica's ring which gives access to the new spirit portals
Ability to fight the level 785 Corporeal Beast
Ability to fight the level 42 Tormented Wraith
Ability to bless spirit shields with holy elixirs by using either component at any Saradomin altar

steps.t: Equip your ghost speak amulet and Talk to Summer at the Wilderness wall, north-east of Varrock. [Chat: Accept]
p: In the Void with the spirits

steps.t: Stand on the white portal. [Chat: any]
After the dialogue, equip and right-click operate Jennica's ring while standing on the portal to return to the real world.
p: Collapsing the cave in the real world will cause it to open in the Spirit Realm

steps.t: Run northwest, past the dead trees to the dungeon, right-click and collapse the entrance.
Go back to the ruins and operate Jennica's ring while standing on the white portal to return to the spirit realm.
Run north and lure the beast to the entrance with your blue charm familiar. Enter the cave before it has a chance to consume your familiar. [Chat: 1 Yes, I am.]
Avoid the beast's ranged attacks by moving away from the missiles.
Chop roots along the walls to obtain cursed willow logs. You will need 15 in total.

sub.t: (Optional) Right-click use an extra log on the middle fire pit, and then lure the Beast behind it to avoid attacks while cutting the remaining logs.

p: Chopping the cursed willow roots used to create the pyres

steps.t: Right-click use 5 logs on one of the fire pits and then light it.

sub.t: Do not light other fire pits during cutscene.

steps.t: Repeat for a total of three fire pits.

sub.t: If you die during the encounter your progress will be saved but unlit logs will be cleared.

steps.t: (Optional) Restock your food and return to Summer to continue.
Enter the next room by going through the passage in the south-east corner. [Chat: 1 Yes, I know what to do.]
Avoid the missiles like before.
Soon a dark core will appear, dig soft soil and lure the core into the hole.

sub.t: Unlike the previous room, all damage is avoidable in this room.
Run around the beast to avoid its missiles, but allow the beast to continuously attack without having to chase you to get the dark core to spawn faster.

p: The dark core trapped in a hole
As the Spirit Beast retrieves its dark core, Jallek prepares to cast his spell

steps.t: Repeat this 3 times until you receive a cutscene.

sub.t: If you die during this encounter, your progress is saved after each trapping.

steps.t: Enter the next room by going through the passage to the east. [Chat: 1 Yes, I am ready.]
Take note of which grave the yellow spirit enters.
Wait for the Beast to charge a yellow attack and bless the grave marker.

sub.t: Blessing a grave consumes prayer points, which may be replenished at the altar in the room.

p: The grave room, with a handy altar to the south

steps.t: Repeat for the red and blue spirit.
Talk to the spirits [Chat: 1 Alright, I'll come with you.] then once outside, talk again.
Quest complete!
